description: Source code for the PrioritizedDispatcher class implementing a job scheduling mechanism with priority handling in the net namespace.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Limits
classes.description: Defines the limits for the dispatcher, including total jobs and reserved slots per priority.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Limits::Limits
methods.description: Constructor initializing limits with number of priorities and total jobs.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::PrioritizedDispatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing dispatcher with specified limits.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Add
methods.description: Adds a job with a specified priority to the dispatcher.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::AddAtHead
methods.description: Adds a job at the front of the queue with a specified priority.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a job using its handle.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::EvictOldestLowest
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest lowest-priority job.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of a job.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::OnJobFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of a job and dispatches next if possible.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::SetLimits
methods.description: Sets new limits for the dispatcher.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::MaybeDispatchJob
methods.description: Attempts to dispatch a specific job if limits allow.

methods.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::MaybeDispatchNextJob
methods.description: Attempts to dispatch the next pending job.
